rules.statement: A public path over a land is not extinguished by a partition decree, affecting the land, to which the Crown is not a party.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 9 of the Partition Ordinance makes the final decree entered in a proceeding under the Partition Ordinance "good and conclusive against all persons whomsoever whatever right or title they have or claim to have in the said property". These words appear to me to contemplate the rights of persons and not such rights as those of the public in a highway which are not the subject of individual personal ownership."
